site_tagline: Three hundred million years of the Dolomites, told from data.
paleolat_model_note: Model value (PALEOMAP). Paleomagnetic data may differ.

observed.title: Observed
observed.explanation: Directly measured today - a lidar surface, a glacier outline.

modeled.title: Modeled
modeled.explanation: The output of a published numerical model, shown with its version and resolution.

interpreted.title: Interpreted
interpreted.explanation: A researcher's reconstruction drawn from field evidence and published in a paper or map.

illustrative.title: Illustrative
illustrative.explanation: Artwork or schematic that carries no claim to spatial accuracy.

alt_globe: Interactive globe showing plate positions and paleogeography at the selected age.
alt_terrain: Three-dimensional terrain view of the Dolomites at the selected time, with coloured geological units and data overlays.

rail.map_globe: Reconstruction of the whole Earth at this time

geology_key.title: Rock age, as mapped
geology_key.edge: Edge of the open geological maps
geology_key.hint: Point at a row to highlight it on the map.
geology_key.undated_withheld: Mapped, age not given or not reliable enough to colour
geology_key.withheld: Mapped, age not reliable enough to colour

geology_popup.age_not_given: Age not given in the source map
geology_popup.gap_text: No open vector geological map covers this area. This is a gap in the open data, not an absence of rock.

basis.source: Age as stated for this unit in the map

withheld_reason.metamorphic_event: it dates a metamorphic or tectonic event, not the rock's formation
withheld_reason.contradiction: it contradicts other age information for this unit
withheld_reason.young_bedrock: it assigns a young age to bedrock
withheld_reason.unmappable_interval: the stated interval has no match in the ICS chart
withheld_reason.open_range: the stated range is open on one side

map_hint.wheel_windows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
map_hint.wheel_mac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
map_hint.touch: Use two fingers to move the map
map_hint.globe_wheel_windows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the globe
map_hint.globe_wheel_mac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the globe
map_hint.globe_touch: Use two fingers to turn the globe
